name: Email alert when a WhatsApp session disconnects

parameters.subject: =WhatsApp session {{ $json.session }} is {{ $json.payload.status }}
parameters.message:
=Session {{ $json.session }} changed to {{ $json.payload.status }} at {{ $now.toISO() }}.

Re-link it in the console: https://whatsapp-messaging.retentionstack.agency/app

parameters.content:
## Session disconnect alert
WhatsApp unlinks devices now and then. This emails you when the session leaves WORKING, so messages don't fail silently.

Set your address in the Gmail node, or swap it for Slack or Telegram.
